title: Image caching got easier to maintain—and better at reading prompts
summary:
The image cache got a sturdier foundation and more precise matching, while eight community projects made the directory a little more useful.

The image cache Worker moved to TypeScript and Hono, with exact and semantic caching separated into testable middleware. Semantic matching now uses multilingual embeddings and the original prompt text, with thresholds that vary by prompt length and tests for small but meaningful differences. Responses distinguish exact from semantic hits; semantic hits also include a similarity score.

The project lists gained image tools, multilingual and multimodal chat, creative utilities, and a photo-identification app. The additions include Imagine Draw AI, Aimpress, Evolve AI, What is this?, Island AI, Botzy AI, Visiora, and aitoolbox.software.

Generation count badges returned to the image and text feeds with corrected displayed rates. Feed-switch labels also stopped being automatically rephrased.
